summary: You love deep, and people feel it. Attraction runs intense and bonds form fast, the kind that change you. Passion and loyalty come naturally bundled together.
body: You love deep, and people feel it. Attraction runs intense and bonds form fast, the kind that change you. Passion and loyalty come naturally bundled together. You don't do shallow; you want the real, transformative kind of connection, and you tend to draw it in. There can be a creative gift here too, a sensitivity that turns into art. The only risk is leaning on the magnetism and skipping the work intimacy still takes. Aim the depth well and you love like few people can.
gift: At your best: magnetic, loyal, capable of love that transforms.
shadow: The trap: trusting the magnetism and skipping the work real intimacy still asks.
integration: Let love and values and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated.
do: Let the depth go somewhere, not just smolder
Channel the intensity into art or devotion
Do the work intimacy takes even when chemistry is easy
dont: Mistake intensity for the whole job
Let the depth turn into possession
